column3: NASB follows the critical text; “being of the number” is rendered “belonging to the number.”
NASB follows the critical text; “captains” is rendered “officers.”
“Master of the house” is rendered “owner of the house.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “everything.”
NASB follows the critical text with “the apostles” (no “twelve”).
NASB renders “With desire I have desired” as “I have earnestly desired.”
NASB follows the critical text; “never again” renders the Textus Receptus “no longer.”
NASB follows the critical text; “divide” is rendered “share.”
NASB adds “some”; the longer text of vv. 19b–20 is printed, as in the critical text.
NASB renders “after the eating” as “after they had eaten” and adds “He took.” It moves “which is poured out for you” next to “cup.”
NASB renders “rule over” as “lord it over” and puts “Benefactors” in quotation marks.
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “it is” and “must.”
NASB reorders the verse and moves “a kingdom” earlier; “appoint” is rendered “grant.”
